abort.single_instance_allowed: Marstek Energy Trader is already set up.
abort.no_marstek: No Marstek Venus Modbus integration was found. Set up the Marstek Venus Modbus integration for your battery first.

error.marstek_missing: These Marstek entities were not found: {entities}. Check that the Marstek Venus Modbus integration is set up for this battery.
error.marstek_disabled: These Marstek entities are disabled: {entities}. Enable them under Settings → Devices → your Marstek → Entities, then try again.
error.invalid_price_sensor: This sensor has no price forecast in a known format (raw_today/raw_tomorrow, prices_today/prices_tomorrow or prices).

user.title: Battery
user.description: Choose the Marstek Venus (from the Marstek Venus Modbus integration). Force mode, the charge/discharge power setpoints and RS485 control mode must be enabled entities.

data_description.battery_power_sign: Look at the Marstek battery power sensor while it charges: positive or negative?
data_description.capacity_kwh: Leave empty to use the capacity the battery reports.
data_description.round_trip_efficiency: Share of the energy you get back after charging and discharging. 85% is a typical value.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: The price sensor needs the prices for the coming hours as an attribute, like ANWB Energie, Nord Pool or ENTSO-e provide.

data_description.price_sensor: The price you pay, including taxes, for example sensor.anwb_energie_stroom_all_in.
data_description.feed_in_mode: What you get for energy you send to the grid.
data_description.feed_in_offset: Only for 'price plus amount'; use a negative amount for a lower feed-in price.
data_description.feed_in_cost: Subtracted from every feed-in price, for example 'terugleverkosten'.

sources.title: Meter, sun and consumption
sources.description: All optional, but they make the plan and the savings more accurate.

data_description.grid_power_sensor: For example the active power of a HomeWizard P1 meter. Used to tell grid and solar energy apart.
data_description.solar_source: Forecast.Solar is built into Home Assistant; Solcast is a HACS integration.
data_description.weather_entity: Used for a rough solar estimate from cloud cover when there is no solar forecast.
data_description.consumption_sensor: Power (W) or energy (kWh) of the house. The average per hour of the last 7 days is used.
data_description.base_load: Used when there is no consumption sensor.
